title: Avijjā
text: 1-5 [As in the preceding] 6 Idha bhikkhu bhikkhuno sutaṃ hoti Dhammā nālam abhinivesāyāti || || Evañce tam bhikkhu bhikkhuno sutaṃ hoti Sabbe dhammā nālam abhinivesāyāti || so sabbam dhammam abhijānāti || sabbaṃ dhammam abhiññāya sabbaṃ dhammam parijānāti || sabbaṃ dhammam pariññāya sabbanimittāni aññato passati || cakkhum aññato passati || rūpe || cakkhuviññāṇam || cakkhusamphassaṃ || || pe || || yam pidaṃ mano samphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ va || tam pi aññato passati || || 7 Evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evam passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti || ||
